name: premortem-llm
description: Personal Codex workflows: diff review; tech-lead, product and design reviews that write tasks to markdown files; commands that implement those tasks and QA them.

interface.shortDescription: Review the project, write tasks to files, implement and QA them.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for strict diff review (diff-review); tech-lead, product and screenshot-based design reviews that write tasks as markdown files (tech-review, pm-review, design-review); adding tasks from any tracker by pasting text and images (add-task); implementing a task (do-task); and QA that tests a finished task (qa-task). Commits and pushes only if the project allows it.
defaultPrompt: Run a tech review of this project.
